title: Toddler Carolyn Jean, Suburban Car Sidewalk - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor portrait of a smiling young toddler identified on the back as Carolyn Jean. She stands on a residential sidewalk wearing a light-colored dress with puffy short sleeves, white socks, and shoes, with her hair styled in a small topknot or ribbon. The neighborhood scene in the background features a late-1940s automobile parked along a tree-lined curb, a utility pole, and a brick-pillared fence next to a house, capturing postwar American suburban childhood.
